metadata.title: 'Insanely good' Taiwan Semi earnings mean nothing to the casino, says Jim Cramer - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
'Insanely good' Taiwan Semi earnings mean nothing to the casino, says Jim Cramer
Loading tweet...
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing's results were stellar. But it seems investors in AI plays have very high expectations, and the chipmaker's stock is slipping.
This is becoming a distinct trend. Recall, Micron Technology's earnings, delivered about three weeks ago, were also barnstorming but still triggered a share slide.
The response to TSM's figures on Thursday is weakness across the chip sector in premarket action, with Micron off more than 2%, Sandisk down nearly 6%, and Advanced Micro Devices slipping nearly 3%.
